_doc: Expert-block tiling for the fused MoE kernel, one entry per measured key.
Keys are (arch, mp_count, m_range); the lookup tries the exact bin, then the arch, then the (null, null) row.
m_range is the band of per-expert rows the numbers were measured for; null means every M.
One band is one compiled variant, so the table is also the list of variants to build - do not add a row per M value.
Only measured numbers belong here: a guessed tiling looks tuned and makes the table lie.

tactics.note: generic starting tactic; not tuned for any MUSA bin yet
